headline: Ghana's GCB Bank Reports 44% Profit Surge
summary: Ghanaian lender GCB Bank reported a 44% increase in nine-month profit to US$60 million. The growth was driven by a surge in fee and trading income during 2026.
why: GCB Bank is a major financial institution in Ghana; its performance is a proxy for the health of the local banking sector.

impacts.name: GCB Bank
impacts.why: Strong earnings growth typically supports share price performance.
